crossRefs.note: Jacob served seven years for Rachel. They seemed to him but a few days, for the love he had for her.
Yahweh saw that Leah was hated, and he opened her womb, but Rachel was barren.
We said to my lord, ‘We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead…
Your servant, my father, said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons.
If a man has two wives, the one beloved and the other hated, and they have borne him children, both the beloved and the…
“No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other; or else he will be devoted to one…
He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t…
“If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and…
He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.
Jacob loved Rachel. He said, “I will serve you seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.”
When Rachel had borne Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, “Send me away, that I may go to my own place, and to my country.
Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served you, and let me go; for you know my service with which I have…
Aren’t we considered as foreigners by him? For he has sold us, and has also used up our money.
These twenty years I have been in your house. I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for…
Saul said to David, “Behold, my elder daughter Merab, I will give her to you as wife. Only be valiant for me, and fight…
Jacob fled into the country of Aram, and Israel served to get a wife, and for a wife he tended flocks and herds.

people.name: Leah
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of six sons and Dinah

people.name: Rachel
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of Joseph and Benjamin

translations.web: He went in also to Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him seven more years.
translations.bsb: Jacob slept with Rachel as well, and indeed, he loved Rachel more than Leah. So he worked for Laban another seven years.
translations.kjv: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.
translations.asv: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.
